Strong stale-overlay criterion counts active exact pixels differing from the correct raw source by more than16 RGB levels and still visible unchanged in the composition. This is not a claim that lossy video itself is exact.
discarded_instrumentation: Original68-full-readback observer read640x360 and encoded RGBA during measured playback; it caused main-thread overhead and apparent8000->500 collapse. Retained as diagnostics, not acceptance.

First marker-only observer still exported and scored full-frame arrays inline between phases. Synchronous NumPy starved the same event loop as the TCP proxy; its narrow phase began at500 and its traffic calculation incorrectly included scoring time. Retained as diagnostics, not acceptance.

The valid early snapshot reports retain a legacy top-level synthetic-source label; their hardcut scope, verified natural RGB manifest and source-counter images identify the actual source. Latest75/77 reports explicitly name the natural source.
post_measurement_note: Backend logs continue during diagnostic full-frame export. Acceptance uses phase-ending stats and rate history captured before export; subsequent debugger-induced stalls are outside the timed media phases.
implementation: Cropped video permits a bounded450ms codec VBV, capped2MiB; existing raw byte admission and RTP pacing pay for all encoded bytes. No future-frame queue or playout cushion is introduced.

Full-desktop fallback retains its original codec rate, one-frame VBV and NVENC P1. Cropped NVENC uses P4 with no B-frames or lookahead; QSV/VAAPI retain their existing presets and require separate qualification.
HEVC QSV keeps its existing VBR selector and at-least-two-frame VBV; cropped max-frame-size follows the bounded burst capacity. No claim that this path has passed the new media tests.

Fresh matched delivery with sufficient byte volume, at least5% faster than offered load and age falling at least5ms identifies draining flight. Old credit waits cannot alone lower the target again. Re-growing queues and RTCP loss remain effective.
RTP/RTX packet costs already include protocol overhead; the pacer now refills at the shared path target, without the former25% multiplier. Audio/UI remain independent and video repays their credit.
The sampled forced-scene-IDR experiment was rejected: it reduced the narrow target further and worsened fidelity; that detector is absent from the candidate.
Severe codec decreases confirmed600ms use1s quiet; ordinary changes retain the original dwell and quiet. The400/500ms transient checks remain.
Recovery requests rejected by the existing250ms PLI guard no longer consume the one-second retry lease. Only actual dispatch consumes it; legacy void callbacks retain their prior behavior.

upstream_reference.notes: Confirms live average/max/VBV reconfiguration, and that CQ clears average bitrate and VBV. Candidate retains bounded VBR rather than CQ.
